narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our exploration of trigonometric ratios! Today, we're diving into a fundamental branch of mathematics called trigonometry. It's a powerful tool that helps us understand the relationships between the sides and angles of triangles, especially right-angled triangles. You might be wondering why this is important. Well, trigonometry is used in countless real-world applications, from architecture and engineering to navigation and even video game development. In this lesson, we'll start by defining what trigonometry is and why these relationships are so crucial. We'll then introduce the concept of trigonometric ratios, which are the building blocks for solving many problems involving triangles. So, get ready to unlock a new way of looking at shapes and measurements!
